A '''blockade''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gobindi]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] occurred in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] under the pretense of heavy [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activity. In reality, the Empire was after the four [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] who had arrived to spy on the [[Mah Dala Infirmary]] a few days prior. The Rebels escaped three weeks later after shutting down the infirmary's [[Project Starscream|bioweapon project]].
